problem: The first implementation permuted S_i,t only among complete-case rows retained in each future-outcome panel. The frozen contract instead states that predictor S_i,t is permuted among eligible colonies within the predictor island-season while future missingness and future values remain fixed.
objective_resolution: Construct the permutation from the full eligible performance-state group at predictor island-season t, then read the permuted predictor values into the fixed complete-case outcome panel by colony position. This preserves the observed future-missingness pattern while allowing all eligible predictor colonies to participate in the frozen exchangeability null.
audit_boundary: The original contract predates both implementations and is not edited.
The earlier result receipt using the complete-case-only permutation must be superseded.
The repair is disclosed because the implementation correction occurred after the first result was observed.
